parameters.n: <int> Total number of nodes in the transportation network.
parameters.num_arcs: <int> Total number of undirected arcs connecting nodes in the network.
parameters.m: <int> Number of nodes designated as origin-destination (OD) nodes.
parameters.num_od_pairs: <int> Total number of origin-destination pairs with traffic flow.
parameters.R: <int> Maximum distance a vehicle can travel on a full tank before needing to refuel.
parameters.p: <int> Number of refueling stations to be located.

nodes.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of this node in the network.
nodes.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of this node in the network.
nodes.weight: <int> Population proxy weight of this node, used to compute traffic flow via the gravity model.

arcs.from: <int> Node identifier at one end of this arc.
arcs.to: <int> Node identifier at the other end of this arc.
arcs.distance: <float> Euclidean distance of this arc between its two endpoint nodes.

od_nodes: <list[int], length m> Node identifiers designated as origin-destination nodes.

od_pairs.origin: <int> Node identifier where this traffic flow originates.
od_pairs.destination: <int> Node identifier where this traffic flow is destined.
od_pairs.flow: <float> Volume of round-trip traffic traveling between the origin and destination.
od_pairs.shortest_path: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of node identifiers forming the shortest path from origin to destination.
od_pairs.path_distance: <float> Total distance of the shortest path from origin to destination.
